_comment: Design of the Hollin's Reach valley stamp, baked by tools_qa/region1/bake_valley.gd into hollins_reach.res (Image RGF: R = metres added, G = terrace tread hint). s = metres along the upper Ashrun from its source at (-150, -900) (the valley head), downstream. Tables are [s, value] pairs, linearly interpolated. West/east are the river's right/left banks looking downstream (south). See docs/regions/LOOK_R1.md.
